text:
My tongue goes where pain guides it;
        I, with my pain, walk unguided;
        together we must go with sure intent;
        each goes to end where it would not.


        I, because I go with no companion
        except the one my folly makes for me;
        it, because it is led by him who came
        to make it say more than it would wish.


        And the law is so unequal for me
        that though it always knows me innocent,
        I always pay for another's fault as mine.


        What blame have I for my tongue's frenzy,
        if I am in such distress
        that suffering itself no longer knows me?

translation.title: My tongue goes where pain guides it
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
